# Newmara

Newmara is a private investment firm that acquires, operates and partners with established businesses and invests in real estate.

## Ways business owners can work with Newmara
- Sell Your Business: full acquisition and ownership transition.
- Business Succession: gradual transition for owners who want to step back over time.
- Partner for Growth: owners can retain meaningful ownership while adding capital and hands on capabilities across sales, marketing, customer acquisition, operations, technology and strategic acquisitions.

## Business focus
- Construction and infrastructure: asphalt, paving, concrete, aggregates, excavation, site development, utilities, roadwork and infrastructure services.
- Trades and home services.
- Manufacturing and industrial businesses.
- Property related businesses and real estate.

## Local markets
Newmara actively builds relationships with business owners across Volusia County and Flagler County, including Daytona Beach, Ormond Beach, Port Orange, New Smyrna Beach, DeLand, Deltona, DeBary, Edgewater, Holly Hill, Orange City, South Daytona, Palm Coast, Bunnell, Flagler Beach and surrounding communities. This local focus does not limit Newmara to these markets.
